title: Speaking — Taking photographs
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on taking photographs.

questions: What do you usually do before leaving home?
At what time of day do you feel most alert?
Which part of your routine would you like to change?
Does your routine change during holidays?
When do you usually take photographs?
How do you decide which photographs to keep?

part2.topic: Describe a photograph that tells a story about a place.
points: what can be seen in it
what was happening at the time
part2.closing: and explain what a stranger might learn from the photograph.

questions: Do photographs influence which destinations people visit?
How does frequent photo-taking affect the way people remember events?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to taking photographs?
